Dialogs.dc.html.title: Send print, Melody creator, command palette

sticky-main.text:
Prepare. Shows the floating 3D canvas, sidebar cards, gizmo rail and Slice/Print split buttons.
Try: Tweaks > Look > accent swatches and the motion switch.
Not built natively yet: rounded canvas corners, Ink list, Process tiles, Express print card, scene toolbar.

sticky-home.text:
Home. Recent files, Online Models, Print History, LAN model drop, printers, Melody creator entry.
Try: accent and motion tweaks; hover the cards.
Not built natively yet: the Home navigation column with Online Models and Print History.

sticky-preview.text:
Preview. View types, display options, legend dock, layer slider, move timeline.
Try: turn motion off to see the static end state.
Not built natively yet: view chips, display options row, layer slider and bottom bar layout.

sticky-device.text:
Device. Camera, progress, speed, temperatures, AMS, fans, light.
Open decision: rail label says Device, native tab says Monitor. Pick one before implementation.
Not built natively yet: the restyled Device screen.

sticky-dialogs.text:
Dialogs. Send print job, Melody creator, command palette with regex search.
Try: accent swatches recolour the primary actions.
Not built natively yet: Send print and Melody creator layouts.

sticky-tokens.text:
Graphite tokens. Colour roles (dark and light), type, shape, elevation, motion.
Try: the accent tweak shows how the primary role reads on every surface.
Built natively: the colour roles (b92da01).

sticky-components.text:
Shared title bar and navigation rail, imported by every screen.
Try: NavRail Tweaks > active destination.
Not built natively yet: title bar menus as text buttons and the extra rail destinations.
